rules.name: Tax disallowance for unpaid MSME dues
rules.description: Expenses towards MSME suppliers not paid within time limit under MSMED Act are disallowed as deduction in ITR

actions.description: Disallow expense deduction for unpaid MSME amount in current FY ITR
Calculate additional tax liability due to disallowance

rules.legal_text: Any sum payable by the assessee to a micro or small enterprise beyond the time limit specified in section 15 of the MSMED Act shall be allowed as deduction only in the previous year in which it is actually paid.
rules.penalty_description: Full amount disallowed from taxable income; increased tax liability

rules.name: Deduction allowed if paid before ITR due date
rules.description: If payment is made before ITR filing deadline, deduction is still allowed in the relevant assessment year

actions.description: Prioritize payment before ITR filing deadline to preserve deduction
Deduction recoverable if paid before filing

rules.legal_text: The deduction shall be allowed in computing the income of the previous year in which the sum is actually paid, irrespective of the previous year in which the liability was incurred.
rules.penalty_description: Deduction preserved if payment made before ITR due date
